title_zh: 依据虚构案例拟定听证提问

scenario.label_zh: 准备虚构州长听证会的问题
scenario.goal_zh: 根据课堂材料区分治理责任与单独定价权限，并写出询问收费决定依据的问题

context_zh: 学生讨论公民教育课提供的虚构州政府案例，不涉及现实地区的法律。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: In this case study, the governor wants to charge a fee for using the park.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Does being elected to govern the state mean she can set any fee she likes?

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: No. The case notes say the assembly must approve new charges.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Then our question at the mock hearing should be about that approval.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: Yes. Ask whether she intends to impose the fee before the vote.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Should we describe our inquiry as an accusation?

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: Not yet. We only know she proposed it, not that anyone has been charged.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: I'll write, 'What approval would be needed before visitors had to pay?'

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: That asks for the missing information without assuming she's broken the rules.

targets.sense_zh: 听取意见或证据的正式听证会
为查明情况而作的询问
